data_pipeline: SAME real-OSM bake as the smarts location map (Overpass -> projector -> viewBox px). In production the river / key roads / parks / POI coords + real walk-minutes come from that bake; here the geometry is hand-authored as a stand-in. Drawn SIMPLIFIED (river + 2 parks + ~5 roads + ~6 POIs), NOT the 823-building dense view.

fidelity.preserveAspectRatio: xMidYMid slice (uniform scale -> circles stay round; NOT 'none', which squashed every circle to an ellipse)
fidelity.pin_positioning: JS maps each POI's viewBox coord (data-tx/ty) -> screen px via svg.getScreenCTM(); the .dot is anchored on that point. Pin + thread-end share ONE source of truth -> 0px misalignment at every viewport; re-layout on resize + ScrollTrigger.onRefresh

threads.shape: quadratic bezier home -> POI, bowed perpendicular to the radius (consistent handedness), magnitude min(34, dist*0.10) -> a graceful even splay (NOT i%2 alternating)
threads.hover: is-hot -> terracotta + thicker; .is-focusing calms the rest to opacity 0.22

composition: editorial column (kicker + Fraunces 300 headline w/ italic terracotta line + lead + legend) | breathing illustrated map. Home centered; POIs spread radially; home tag BELOW the marker clear of the convergence.

palette.accent_ink: #9a5238 (SMALL text: kicker, hot label, focus ring — WCAG AA on cream)

a11y.svg: role=img + aria-label (map = one image; threads/pins decorative)
a11y.legend: role=list; rows role=listitem + aria-label 'Назва, N хвилин пішки', tabindex=0, focus lights the pin+thread
a11y.contrast: all small text darkened to >=4.5:1 on cream
